{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

dd = open('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/data_dictionary.md', 'r').read()

# Inspect the first few rows
print('First 5 rows:')
print(trial_df.head())

# Check for duplicates and structure
print('\nShape:', trial_df.shape)
print('\nUnique patient_ids:', trial_df['patient_id'].nunique())
print('\nSample_seq max per patient:')
print(trial_df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().value_counts())

# Check if there are multiple rows per patient
print('\nPatients with multiple sample_seq:')
print(trial_df['patient_id'].value_counts().loc[lambda x: x > 1])

# Check which rows to keep: highest sample_seq per patient
trial_df_sorted = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
trial_df_deduped = trial_df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

print('\nAfter deduplication:')
print('Shape:', trial_df_deduped.shape)
print('Unique patient_ids:', trial_df_deduped['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check for missing values
print('\nMissing values:')
print(trial_df_deduped.isnull().sum())

# Check the 'assay' column: what values?
print('\nUnique assay values:')
print(trial_df_deduped['assay'].unique())

# Check the 'responded' column
print('\nResponse rate by arm:')
print(trial_df_deduped.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean())

# Check for imbalances in baseline severity
print('\nBaseline severity by arm:')
print(trial_df_deduped.groupby('arm')['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True))"}
